## Overview

LRP196 is the **ability-adjusted** companion to [LRP096](../lrp-rli-mech-096/). It is the same
Tier-1 mechanism model — same exposure, outcome, own-baseline term, subject random
intercept and linear parameterisation — with `blocks` (WPPSI Block Design) added to the
matched conditioning set.

This variant adjusts for baseline block design to assess whether measured non-verbal ability accounts for the letter-sound association. Block design is available for all archived children and is held fixed across waves. It is a proxy for general ability; adjusting for it cannot establish that all ability-related confounding has been removed.

Role in the panel: **positive control** — the pure-decoding channel.

## Model

$$
\eta = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{phase}} + \beta_G G
  + \beta_{\text{mech}}\, z(\operatorname{logit}_* L_{\text{post}})
  + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(N_{\text{pre}})
  + \gamma_A z(A) + \gamma_{\text{blocks}} z(\text{blocks})
  + \sum_c \gamma_c z(c) + u_{\text{child}}.
$$

The added term relative to LRP096 is $\gamma_{\text{blocks}} z(\text{blocks})$.
`blocks` is a single noisy subtest rather than the latent ability node, so residual
confounding survives this adjustment and $\beta_{\text{mech}}$ remains an **adjusted
association**.
